column4: Description

Munich-based B2B SaaS data product management platform Mindfuel raised €3.75M ($4.0M USD) in seed funding led by Project A Ventures. Headquartered in Munich, Germany. Founded by Nadiem von Heydebrand. [HQ: Germany | Founder: Nadiem von Heydebrand | Funding: raised $4.0M in seed funding]

Swiss cybersecurity startup Saporo raised $2.7M in seed funding to expand its cloud attack surface reduction platform. Based in Lausanne, Switzerland. Co-founded by Olivier Eyries and Eric Blavier. [HQ: Switzerland | Founder: Olivier Eyries | Funding: raised $2.7M seed funding]

Cluj-Napoca-based cloud cybersecurity automation platform Cyscale secured €3M ($3.2M USD) in seed funding led by Notion Capital. Headquartered in Romania, Europe. Founded by Manuela Ticudean and Ovidiu Cical. [HQ: Romania | Founder: Ovidiu Cical | Funding: secured $3.2M seed round]

AI healthtech and 3D foot scanning software Neatsy raised $1.0M in seed funding from Cabra VC. Headquartered in London, United Kingdom. Founded by Artem Semyanov. [HQ: United Kingdom | Founder: Artem Semyanov | Funding: raised $1.0M seed funding]

Paris-based carbon footprint software platform for apparel Carbonfact secured €1.9M ($2.1M USD) in seed funding from Alven. Headquartered in Paris, France. Founded by Martin Daniel and Marc Laurent. [HQ: France | Founder: Martin Daniel | Funding: secured $2.1M seed round]

Bengaluru-based security compliance and automated audit platform Sprinto raised $3.5M in seed funding led by Elevation Capital. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India. Co-founded by Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla. [HQ: India | Founder: Girish Redekar | Funding: raised $3.5M in seed funding]

Gurugram-based open source Kubernetes software delivery and deployment platform Devtron raised $3.0M in seed funding from Nexus Venture Partners. Headquartered in Gurugram, India. Co-founded by Prashant Ghildiyal. [HQ: India | Founder: Prashant Ghildiyal | Funding: raised $3.0M in seed round]

Bengaluru-based IoT software architecture and edge device management platform Bytebeam raised $3.0M in seed funding led by Together Fund. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India. Founded by Gautam Dayal. [HQ: India | Founder: Gautam Dayal | Funding: raised $3.0M seed funding]

Bengaluru-based LLMOps and enterprise AI gateway platform Portkey raised $3.0M in seed funding from Lightspeed India. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India. Co-founded by Rohit Agarwal and Ayush Garg. [HQ: India | Founder: Rohit Agarwal | Funding: raised $3.0M in seed funding]

Beijing-based conversational foundation AI and enterprise platform Zhipu raised $4.5M in early strategic round from venture consortium. Headquartered in Beijing, China. Founded by Jie Tang. [HQ: China | Founder: Jie Tang | Funding: raised $4.5M in venture financing]

Tokyo-based AI-powered test automation SaaS platform Autify raised $2.5M in seed extension from Global Brain. Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Founded by Ryo Chikazawa. [HQ: Japan | Founder: Ryo Chikazawa | Funding: raised $2.5M in seed funding]

Biome Makers uses DNA sequencing and ecological computing to decode soil biology and improve crop yield for agriculture. Headquartered in Valladolid, Spain. Founded by Alberto Acedo. [HQ: Spain | Founder: Alberto Acedo | Funding: secured $4.2M in funding]

Qure.ai deploys deep learning AI tools for medical radiology and diagnostic chest X-ray interpretation in hospitals. Headquartered in Mumbai, India. Founded by Prashant Warier. [HQ: India | Founder: Prashant Warier | Funding: raised $4.5M venture financing]

Doctolib provides online medical consultations, appointment management, and digital hospital software solutions across Europe. Headquartered in Paris, France. Founded by Stanislas Niox-Chateau. [HQ: France | Founder: Stanislas Niox-Chateau | Funding: raised €4.0M early growth round]

Ultraviolette Automotive develops high-performance electric motorcycles and aviation-grade EV battery technology. Headquartered in Bangalore, India. Founded by Narayan Subramaniam. [HQ: India | Founder: Narayan Subramaniam | Funding: secured $3.2M Series A funding]

Rimac Technology engineers high-performance electric powertrains, battery management systems, and automotive electronics. Headquartered in Sveta Nedelja, Croatia. Founded by Mate Rimac. [HQ: Croatia | Founder: Mate Rimac | Funding: secured €4.5M early development round]

Climeworks develops and operates commercial direct air capture plants to permanently remove carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Founded by Christoph Gebald. [HQ: Switzerland | Founder: Christoph Gebald | Funding: raised $4.8M early financing]

Zetwerk provides custom on-demand manufacturing, precision machining, and industrial fabrication supply network services. Headquartered in Bangalore, India. Founded by Amrit Acharya. [HQ: India | Founder: Amrit Acharya | Funding: raised $3.0M early seed financing]

Sennder connects commercial enterprise shippers with freight carriers through its European digital road logistics platform. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Founded by David Nothacker. [HQ: Germany | Founder: David Nothacker | Funding: secured €3.5M funding]

Singapore-based B2B cross-border payments & fx API platform Modus raised $2.3M in seed round led by Wavemaker Partners. Headquartered in Singapore. Founded by Patrick Murphy. [HQ: Singapore | Founder: Patrick Murphy | Funding: raised $2.3M in seed round]

Singapore-based treasury management and cross-border API payments platform Finmo raised $3.5M in seed funding led by Quona Capital. Headquartered in Singapore. Founded by David Hanna. [HQ: Singapore | Founder: David Hanna | Funding: raised $3.5M in seed round]

Jakarta-based merchant digital financial platform BukuKas raised $3.2M in seed funding from Surge. Headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia. Founded by Krishnan Menon. [HQ: Indonesia | Founder: Krishnan Menon | Funding: raised $3.2M in seed capital]

Shanghai-based large language model platform Moonshot secured $3.8M in seed funding. Headquartered in Shanghai, China. Founded by Yang Zhilin. [HQ: China | Founder: Yang Zhilin | Funding: secured $3.8M seed round]

Stellapps Technologies digitizes the dairy supply chain with farm-side IoT, milk quality testing, and cold-chain analytics. Headquartered in Bangalore, India. Founded by Ranjith Mukundan. [HQ: India | Founder: Ranjith Mukundan | Funding: secured $2.5M in funding round]

Sydney-based bot management and cybersecurity platform Kasada raised $4.5M in early round financing led by In-Q-Tel and Ten11. Headquartered in Sydney, Australia. Founded by Sam Crowther. [HQ: Australia | Founder: Sam Crowther | Funding: raised $4.5M in funding]

Melbourne-based construction management SaaS platform Buildxact raised $3.8M in Series A funding from Saluda. Headquartered in Melbourne, Australia. Founded by David Murray. [HQ: Australia | Founder: David Murray | Funding: raised $3.8M in Series A round]

Tel Aviv-based data security posture management platform Kite Security raised $3.0M in seed funding led by Team8. Headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel. Founded by Alon Yamin. [HQ: Israel | Founder: Alon Yamin | Funding: raised $3.0M seed funding]

Sao Paulo-based car subscription software & IoT fleet platform Kovi raised $3.2M in seed round from Monashees. Headquartered in Sao Paulo, Brazil. Founded by Adhemar Milani Neto. [HQ: Brazil | Founder: Adhemar Milani Neto | Funding: raised $3.2M in seed funding]

Johannesburg-based AI insurtech platform Naked Insurance secured $3.0M in seed financing led by Yellowwoods. Headquartered in Johannesburg, South Africa. Founded by Alex Thomson. [HQ: South Africa | Founder: Alex Thomson | Funding: secured $3.0M seed round]

Cape Town-based automated bank-to-bank payments and open banking platform Ozow raised $3.5M in Series A round. Headquartered in Cape Town, South Africa. Founded by Thomas Pays. [HQ: South Africa | Founder: Thomas Pays | Funding: raised $3.5M in Series A round]

Dubai-based payments platform Tabby secured $4.0M in seed funding from Mubadala. Headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Co-founded by Hosam Arab. [HQ: United Arab Emirates | Founder: Hosam Arab | Funding: secured $4.0M seed financing]

Fasal operates an AI-powered precision agriculture platform with IoT micro-climate and soil sensors for horticulture farmers. Headquartered in Bangalore, India. Founded by Shailendra Tiwari. [HQ: India | Founder: Shailendra Tiwari | Funding: raised $1.6M seed funding]

PharmEasy operates a consumer healthcare platform supplying verified pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, and teleconsultation. Headquartered in Mumbai, India. Founded by Dharmil Sheth and Dhaval Shah. [HQ: India | Founder: Dharmil Sheth | Funding: raised ₹50 Crore early funding]

Ecozen manufactures smart solar-powered cold storage (Ecofrost) and smart solar irrigation controllers for farmers. Headquartered in Pune, India. Founded by Devendra Gupta and Prateek Singhal. [HQ: India | Founder: Devendra Gupta | Funding: raised $3.8M in funding round]

Bengaluru-based financial inclusion and lending platform InPrime raised $3.4M in Series A funding led by InfoEdge Ventures. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India. Founded by Rajat Singh. [HQ: India | Founder: Rajat Singh | Funding: raised $3.4M Series A funding]

DeHaat provides end-to-end agricultural supply chain solutions, AI advisory, quality seeds, and agro processing to millions of Indian farmers. Headquartered in Patna, India. Founded by Shashank Kumar. [HQ: India | Founder: Shashank Kumar | Funding: raised $4.5M in institutional round]

Synthesized raised $2.8M in seed funding to expand its synthetic data generation platform for enterprise ML and software testing. Headquartered in London, United Kingdom. Co-founded by Dr. Nicolai Baldin. [HQ: United Kingdom | Founder: Nicolai Baldin | Funding: raised $2.8M seed round]
